## Attach the public export

Drag the JSON file from **Options > Data > Public galaxy data > Export public
data** into this issue. Large files can be zipped (GitHub limit: 25 MB).

Only attach the special public export, **never a full backup or diagnostic log**.
Review your file before uploading. Attachments are publicly accessible.
The addon never uploads files; submitting this issue and attaching the file
are your explicit manual actions.

By submitting, you agree to publication of your contribution under the
repository's MPL-2.0 license to the extent you hold applicable rights.
Contribute only non-personal galaxy structure, not player/ownership or upgraded
colony data. The maintainer validates and decides what enters the dataset.
